class.name: SteamPublisher
class.brief_description: Owns one trusted Steam Web API scope.
class.description: Available only in an explicit publisher build for a server or operator tool. Keep this scope alive while its services or verified identities are in use.

method.name: boot
method.description: Validates and snapshots settings and the attached trusted host. Resolves the credential on the first request.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Returns whether the publisher still belongs to its original attached host generation.

method.name: close
method.description: Invalidates the issuer and its services. Pending local observations settle on the next host tick.

method.name: auth
method.description: Returns the trusted authentication and ownership service, or null if the scope has closed.

method.name: leaderboards
method.description: Returns the trusted leaderboard service, or null if the scope has closed.

method.name: game_notifications
method.description: Returns the scoped game notification service, or null if the scope has closed. Durable mutations require an injected [member SteamPublisherSettings.notification_store].

method.name: moderation
method.description: Returns the scoped publisher moderation service, or null if the scope has closed. Actions require an injected [member SteamPublisherSettings.moderation_policy].

method.name: purchases
method.description: Returns the scoped trusted Steam Wallet service, or null if the scope has closed. Actions require an injected [member SteamPublisherSettings.purchase_store].

method.name: inventory
method.description: Returns the trusted Steam Inventory service for this app, or null if the scope has closed.
